name: zcode-token-usage
description: Token usage footer for ZCode: shows how many tokens each task actually consumed, right at the bottom of the task.

plugins.name: token-usage
plugins.description: Shows how many tokens each task actually consumed. A Stop hook sums the real per-call model usage recorded for the finished turn and posts a compact footer (input/output/cache breakdown, call count, model) at the bottom of the task. Includes a /tokens command and a local usage archive.

description_i18n.en: Shows how many tokens each task actually consumed. A Stop hook sums the real per-call model usage recorded for the finished turn and posts a compact footer (input/output/cache breakdown, call count, model) at the bottom of the task. Includes a /tokens command and a local usage archive.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 显示每个任务实际消耗的 Token 数量：通过 Stop hook 按任务汇总模型 API 调用的真实用量，在任务底部以一行页脚展示（输入/输出/缓存拆分、调用次数、模型）。附带 /tokens 查询命令与本地用量留档。
